mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate indicates monetary easing, which lowers borrowing costs and increases consumer and business spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS declines but SPX 20-day returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts reflects stronger consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases but SPX 60-day returns are negative more than 35% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate indicates labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises above 4.5% but SPX 20-day returns are positive more than 30% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP and payroll employment both increase, it signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If both GDPC1 and PAYEMS increase but SPX 60-day returns are negative more than 25% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates stronger supply chains and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases but SPX 20-day returns are negative more than 35% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When federal funds rate is high and GDP growth slows, it indicates tightening monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days in late-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is high and GDPC1 slows but SPX 20-day returns are positive more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate indicates tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2%.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS exceeds 2% but SPX 5-day returns are positive more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real consumer spending reflects strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases but SPX 20-day returns are negative more than 30% of the time.
